notes.md: - **Padma Shri:** **Shaik Nazar** (Guntur) received the **Padma Shri in 1986** for the folk art of **Burrakatha**.

new.s: Who began the rule of the Aravidu dynasty of Vijayanagara?
new.x: Tirumala Deva Raya began Aravidu rule after the Tuluva line ended with Sadasiva.
new.angle: U0121 notes gap: Aravidu rule began with Tirumala Deva Raya

new.s: In which year was the Battle of Talikota fought?
new.x: The Battle of Talikota was fought in January 1565; Rama Raya was beheaded in it.
new.angle: U0121 notes gap: Talikota 1565

new.s: By what other name is the Battle of Talikota known?
new.x: Talikota (1565) is also called Rakshasi-Tangadi or Bannihatti.
new.angle: U0121 notes gap: Talikota = Rakshasi-Tangadi / Bannihatti

new.s: With whose help did Krishnadevaraya take the Kondaveedu fort by splitting Veerabhadra Gajapati's army?
new.x: Kondaveedu was taken with the help of Prime Minister Saluva Timmarusu, who split Veerabhadra Gajapati's army.
new.angle: U0121 notes gap: Kondaveedu taken with Timmarusu's help

new.s: Which Portuguese governor captured Goa from Bijapur in 1510 with Krishnadevaraya's backing?
new.x: Through his envoy Luis, Krishnadevaraya backed Albuquerque's capture of Goa from Bijapur in 1510.
new.angle: U0121 notes gap: Albuquerque - Goa 1510

new.s: To which deity did Krishnadevaraya dedicate Amuktamalyada?
new.x: Amuktamalyada was written at the bidding of Andhra Mahavishnu of Srikakulam but dedicated to Lord Venkateswara.
new.angle: U0121 notes gap: Amuktamalyada dedicated to Venkateswara

new.s: Who wrote Ramabhyudayamu?
new.x: Ayyalaraju Ramabhadrudu, one of the Ashtadiggajas, wrote Ramabhyudayamu, the Ramayana in Telugu.
new.angle: U0121 notes gap: Ramabhyudayamu -> Ayyalaraju Ramabhadrudu

new.s: By what popular name was the Ashtadiggaja poet Nandi Timmana known?
new.x: Nandi Timmana, author of Parijatapaharanamu, was called Mukku Timmana.
new.angle: U0121 notes gap: Nandi Timmana = Mukku Timmana

new.s: By what other name was the poet Ramarajabhushana known?
new.x: Ramarajabhushana, author of Vasucharitramu and Narasabhupaliyamu, was also called Bhattumurti.
new.angle: U0121 notes gap: Ramarajabhushana = Bhattumurti

new.s: Krishnadevaraya's reign is regarded as the golden age of which literature?
new.x: His reign, with the Ashtadiggajas, is called the golden age of Telugu literature (the Prabandha era).
new.angle: U0121 notes gap: golden age of Telugu literature

new.s: By what name is the period of Telugu literature under Krishnadevaraya known?
new.x: Krishnadevaraya's reign is the Prabandha era, the golden age of Telugu literature.
new.angle: U0121 notes gap: Prabandha era

new.s: Where were the three trilingual Sadasivakona inscriptions of 1554 CE found by the ASI in June 2026?
new.x: The Sadasivakona inscriptions were found in the Seshachalam forest of Tirupati district.
new.angle: U0121 notes gap: Sadasivakona inscriptions -> Seshachalam, Tirupati

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Sadasivakona inscriptions:
1. They are written in Telugu, Tamil and Kannada.
2. They record the transfer of Kaanika taxes from Gudimallam temple lands.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: The three 1554 CE inscriptions are trilingual (Telugu, Tamil, Kannada) and record Sadasiva Raya's holy bath and the transfer of Kaanika taxes from Gudimallam temple lands.
new.angle: U0121 notes gap: Sadasivakona inscriptions -> languages, content

new.s: Which British officer, assisted by Campbell, crushed the Palegars of Rayalaseema?
new.x: Thomas Munro, with his officer Campbell, crushed the Palegars and then introduced the Ryotwari system.
new.angle: U0122 notes gap: Palegars suppressed by Munro

new.s: What were the land-tax documents of the Vijayanagara period called?
new.x: Land-tax documents of the Vijayanagara period were called Adhuvanatantram.
new.angle: U0122 notes gap: land-tax documents = Adhuvanatantram

new.s: Which Vijayanagara ruler first remitted the marriage tax?
new.x: The marriage tax was first remitted by Saluva Narasimha and later abolished under Sadasiva Raya.
new.angle: U0122 notes gap: marriage tax first remitted by Saluva Narasimha

new.s: Which was the most important Andhra rajya of the Vijayanagara empire, covering the Paka and Muliki districts (Nellore, Kadapa)?
new.x: Udayagiri was the most important Andhra rajya and was governed by royal princes under the first dynasty.
new.angle: U0122 notes gap: Udayagiri most important Andhra rajya

new.s: What was the village head called Reddi in Andhra known as in Karnataka?
new.x: The Reddi was the village head and revenue collector of Andhra; in Karnataka he was the Gauda.
new.angle: U0122 notes gap: Reddi = Gauda in Karnataka

new.s: Who wrote the Matla-us-Sadain?
new.x: The Persian envoy Abdur Razzaq described Vijayanagara under Devaraya II in his Matla-us-Sadain.
new.angle: U0123 notes gap: Matla-us-Sadain -> Abdur Razzaq

new.s: In which work did Abdur Razzaq record his visit to Vijayanagara?
new.x: Abdur Razzaq wrote the Matla-us-Sadain; Journey Beyond Three Seas is Nikitin's work.
new.angle: U0123 notes gap: Abdur Razzaq -> Matla-us-Sadain

new.s: Who was the earliest European to visit Vijayanagara?
new.x: The Italian Nicolo de Conti (1420-21, under Devaraya I) was the earliest European visitor.
new.angle: U0123 notes gap: earliest European visitor = Conti

new.s: During whose reign did Ibn Battuta visit Vijayanagara?
new.x: Ibn Battuta of Morocco, the first foreign traveller to Vijayanagara, came under Harihara I.
new.angle: U0123 notes gap: Ibn Battuta -> Harihara I

new.s: Which kingdom did the Russian traveller Athanasius Nikitin visit?
new.x: Nikitin visited the Bahmani kingdom under Muhammad III and wrote Journey Beyond Three Seas.
new.angle: U0123 notes gap: Nikitin -> Bahmani kingdom

new.s: Which foreign traveller wrote a dynastic history of Vijayanagara, including its foundation legend?
new.x: Fernao Nuniz, a Portuguese horse dealer, wrote on the dynasty's history and foundation legend.
new.angle: U0123 notes gap: Nuniz -> dynastic history

new.s: According to Fernao Nuniz, how many amara troops did the Vijayanagara nayakas maintain?
new.x: Nuniz put the amara troops at 600,000; Conti put the army at 90,000.
new.angle: U0123 notes gap: Nuniz 600,000 amara troops

new.s: Which form of marriage was the most popular in Vijayanagara society?
new.x: Brahma vivaha, in which the father gives his daughter to a suitable groom, was the most popular form.
new.angle: U0123 notes gap: Brahma vivaha most popular

new.s: Who built the Narasambudhi tank in Anantapur?
new.x: Saluva Narasimha built the Narasambudhi tank; Bukka I built the Siruveru tank.
new.angle: U0123 notes gap: Narasambudhi -> Saluva Narasimha

new.s: Which tank did Krishnadevaraya build with the help of Portuguese engineers?
new.x: Krishnadevaraya built the Nagalapuram tank with Portuguese engineers, besides the Toragallu dam and Kambham tank.
new.angle: U0123 notes gap: Nagalapuram tank - Portuguese engineers

new.s: Tank-building was counted among the Saptasantanas. What were the Saptasantanas?
new.x: The Saptasantanas were the seven meritorious acts, and tank-building was one of them.
new.angle: U0123 notes gap: Saptasantanas = seven meritorious acts

new.s: According to the Burhan-i-Maasir, what was Sadasiva Raya's yearly income?
new.x: The Nizam Shahi chronicle Burhan-i-Maasir put Sadasiva Raya's yearly income at 12 crore huns.
new.angle: U0123 notes gap: Burhan-i-Maasir - 12 crore huns

new.s: What were 'Devadaya' in the Vijayanagara period?
new.x: Devadaya were temple villages or endowments; Sri Bhandara was the temple treasury.
new.angle: U0123 notes gap: Devadaya = temple villages

new.s: Which places were centres of silk production in the Vijayanagara period?
new.x: Gutti and Rayadurg were silk centres; Vajrakarur polished diamonds.
new.angle: U0123 notes gap: silk -> Gutti, Rayadurg

new.s: By which other names was the Vijayanagara gold coin Varaha known?
new.x: The Varaha, the largest gold coin, was also called Pagoda, Gadyana or Honnu; Mada was the Pratapa.
new.angle: U0123 notes gap: Varaha = Pagoda/Gadyana/Honnu

new.s:
Match the following:
List-I (Coin symbol)
a. Hanuman
b. Venkateswara and Balakrishna
c. Garuda
d. Varaha
List-II (Ruler)
1. Tirumala Raya
2. Achyutaraya
3. Krishnadevaraya
4. Harihara and Bukka
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
new.x: Hanuman appears on coins of Harihara and Bukka, Venkateswara and Balakrishna on Krishnadevaraya's, Garuda on Achyutaraya's and Varaha on Tirumala Raya's.
new.angle: U0123 notes gap: coin symbol -> ruler

new.s: What is the popular name of the Virupaksha temple at Hampi?
new.x: The Virupaksha (Shiva) temple, the first and largest at Hampi, is popularly called Pampapati.
new.angle: U0124 notes gap: Virupaksha = Pampapati

new.s: To which deity is the Achyutaraya temple at Hampi dedicated?
new.x: The Achyutaraya temple (1534) is dedicated to Tiruvengalanatha, a form of Vishnu.
new.angle: U0124 notes gap: Achyutaraya temple -> Tiruvengalanatha

new.s: Which of the following at Hampi is credited to Krishnadevaraya?
o: Enlargement of the Virupaksha temple by Lakkana Dandesha
new.x: Krishnadevaraya made the Ugra Narasimha, Hanuman statue and monolithic Ganesha; the other works belong to Achyutaraya's and Devaraya II's reigns.
new.angle: U0124 notes gap: Krishnadevaraya -> Ugra Narasimha

new.s: Near which town is the Lepakshi temple located?
new.x: The Lepakshi Veerabhadra temple stands on Kurma Shailam hill near Hindupur, Sri Sathya Sai district.
new.angle: U0124 notes gap: Lepakshi near Hindupur

new.s: By what other name is the Veerabhadra temple at Lepakshi known?
new.x: The Lepakshi Veerabhadra temple is also called the Papanaseswara temple.
new.angle: U0124 notes gap: Lepakshi = Papanaseswara

new.s: Where was the state launch of Yogandhra-2026 held on 8 June 2026?
new.x: The state launch of Yogandhra-2026 was held at Lepakshi on 8 June 2026.
new.angle: U0124 notes gap: Yogandhra-2026 at Lepakshi

new.s: In which district is the Ontimitta Kodandarama temple located?
new.x: The Vijayanagara-era Kodandarama temple of Ontimitta is in Kadapa district.
new.angle: U0124 notes gap: Ontimitta -> Kadapa

new.s: Which temple is the venue of Andhra Pradesh's official Sri Rama Navami celebrations?
new.x: Ontimitta Kodandarama temple, linked with Pothana, is the venue of AP's official Sri Rama Navami; Bhadrachalam is now in Telangana.
new.angle: U0124 notes gap: Ontimitta - official Sri Rama Navami

new.s: In March 2026, inscriptions of Achyutaraya (1534 CE) were found on a 50-ft monolithic pillar of which temple?
new.x: The 1534 CE inscriptions were found on the 50-ft monolithic pillar of the Somapalayam Chennakesava temple in Annamayya district.
new.angle: U0124 notes gap: Somapalayam pillar inscriptions

new.s: Who looted the idols of Gandikota in 1657?
new.x: Mir Jumla looted the idols of Gandikota in 1657.
new.angle: U0124 notes gap: Gandikota - Mir Jumla

new.s: A record of which Vijayanagara ruler calls Gooty foremost among forts?
new.x: Gooty, one of AP's oldest hill forts, is called foremost among forts in a record of Bukka I.
new.angle: U0124 notes gap: Gooty - Bukka I record

new.s: According to Domingo Paes, why did the walls of Vijayanagara enclose fields and gardens?
o: To separate the royal centre from temples
new.x: Paes noted that the walls enclosed agricultural tracts so the city could withstand sieges.
new.angle: U0124 notes gap: fort design - sieges (Paes)

new.s: In which present-day district of Karnataka is Hampi located?
new.x: Hampi, on the southern bank of the Tungabhadra, is in Vijayanagara district of Karnataka.
new.angle: U0124 notes gap: Hampi -> Vijayanagara district

new.s: With which region is Harikatha most deeply rooted?
new.x: Harikatha is deeply rooted in Vizianagaram, home of Adibhatla Narayana Dasu.
new.angle: U0125 notes gap: Harikatha -> Vizianagaram

new.s: Which organisation used folk plays such as Burrakatha to spread socialist ideals?
new.x: The Praja Natya Mandali used folk plays for socialist ideals; its hit play was Mabhoomi.
new.angle: U0125 notes gap: Praja Natya Mandali -> socialist ideals

new.s: Who wrote the Burrakathas Kashtajeevi, Raithu Vijayam and Alluri Sitaramaraju?
new.x: Sunkara Satyanarayana wrote these Burrakathas and co-wrote Mabhoomi.
new.angle: U0125 notes gap: Sunkara Satyanarayana -> Burrakathas

new.s: Veeranatyam, performed in Shiva temples, is the dance of which deity?
new.x: Veeranatyam, performed by the Veeramushti, is the 'dance of Veerabhadra'.
new.angle: U0125 notes gap: Veeranatyam = dance of Veerabhadra

new.s: Whose help did Vijayarama Raju of Vizianagaram take in the Bobbili War of 1757?
new.x: Vijayarama Raju took French help under Bussy in the Bobbili War (1757).
new.angle: U0125 notes gap: Bobbili War - French (Bussy)

new.s: In which year was Sheikh Nazar awarded the Padma Shri for Burrakatha?
new.x: The Gazette list of Padma Shri awards of 26 January 1986 names Shaik Nazar (Folk Art of Burrakatha), Guntur.
new.angle: U0125 web: #6 folk artist -> award: Sheikh Nazar Padma Shri 1986

new.s: Which Burrakatha artist from Guntur received the Padma Shri in 1986?
new.x: Shaik Nazar, the Burrakatha Pitamaha, received the Padma Shri in 1986; Miriyala Apparao got it in 2025.
new.angle: U0125 web: #6 folk artist -> award: Padma Shri 1986 -> Sheikh Nazar

new.s: What is the leader of a Kolattam group called?
new.x: The Kolattam (Dandalasyam) group of 8 or 12 dancers is led by the Pennadi.
new.angle: U0126 notes gap: Kolattam leader = Pennadi

new.s: How many dancers usually make up a Kolattam group?
new.x: Kolattam is a stick dance of 8 or 12 dancers.
new.angle: U0126 notes gap: Kolattam 8 or 12 dancers

new.s: Keelugurram (Ashwa Nrutyam), the dummy-horse dance, is associated with which district?
new.x: Keelugurram, the dummy-horse dance, belongs to Guntur.
new.angle: U0126 notes gap: Keelugurram -> Guntur

new.s: Namala Singadu Nrutyam, a solo dance from Namala village, belongs to which district?
new.x: Namala Singadu Nrutyam is a solo dance from Namala village, Anantapur.
new.angle: U0126 notes gap: Namala Singadu -> Anantapur

new.s: In which folk dance of Andhra do dancers wear large hollow figures or masks?
new.x: In Butta Bommalu dancers wear large hollow figures/masks; Garagalu uses pots on the head.
new.angle: U0126 notes gap: Butta Bommalu - masks

new.s: By what old name was the village of Kuchipudi known?
new.x: Kuchipudi, the village in Krishna district that gave the dance its name, was called Kuchelapuram.
new.angle: U0126 notes gap: Kuchipudi = Kuchelapuram

new.s: During the Tirupati Gangamma Jatara, men dress in women's attire. What is this called?
new.x: In the nine-day Gangamma Jatara men wear women's attire (Perantalu Vesham); Chapparalu are bamboo structures.
new.angle: U0126 notes gap: Gangamma Jatara - Perantalu Vesham

new.s: Which deity is worshipped at Kotappakonda?
new.x: Kotappakonda in Palnadu is a Shiva (Trikoteswara) centre famous for Maha Sivaratri prabhas.
new.angle: U0126 notes gap: Kotappakonda - Trikoteswara

new.s: In which district is Kondapalli, known for its GI-tagged toys, located?
new.x: Kondapalli, whose toys are made of light Tella Poniki wood, is in NTR district.
new.angle: U0126 notes gap: Kondapalli -> NTR district

new.s: In which year did Budithi bell and brass craft receive its GI tag?
new.x: Budithi bell and brass craft of Srikakulam got its GI tag in 2008.
new.angle: U0126 notes gap: Budithi GI 2008

new.s: In which year did Tirupati Laddu receive its GI tag?
new.x: Tirupati Laddu got its GI tag in 2009; Bandar Laddu and Banganapalle mango in 2017.
new.angle: U0126 notes gap: Tirupati Laddu GI 2009

new.s: Which is the state nodal agency for handicrafts in Andhra Pradesh, selling under the name 'Lepakshi'?
new.x: Lepakshi, run by the A.P. Handicrafts Development Corporation (APHDC), is the state handicrafts nodal agency.
new.angle: U0126 notes gap: Lepakshi (APHDC) handicrafts agency

new.s: Where was a 90-foot installation of Etikoppaka toys unveiled in August 2026?
o: Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport, Bhogapuram
new.x: On 2 August 2026 a 90-foot Etikoppaka toy installation was unveiled at Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport, Bhogapuram.
new.angle: U0126 notes gap: Etikoppaka installation at Bhogapuram airport

new.s: In which district is Dwaraka Tirumala, called 'Dakshina Dwaraka', located?
new.x: Dwaraka Tirumala, the Dakshina Dwaraka, is in Eluru district.
new.angle: U0126 notes gap: Dwaraka Tirumala -> Eluru district
